name: Getting Started at the Piano
equipment: A piano or keyboard (61+ keys recommended)
instructions: Sit with your bench height set so your forearms are roughly level with the keys, elbows close to your body.
Find middle C: it is the C key nearest the center of a full keyboard, just left of the group of two black keys.
Curve your fingers naturally, as if gently holding a ball, rather than playing with flat, stiff fingers.
Watch today's video for a full walkthrough of getting started.
